summary: Quorum holds a careful, evidence-tagged hook system (695 lines of docs, a shared engine with lint and gates, libraries of 50 quiz, 12 news and 16 MMA hooks), the GoVIRAL sends-first ranking, and four vendored MIT marketing skills at 7868cb9. None of it reaches the DNESKAi Instagram pipeline in OwnDashboard: the news library serves only Quorum's paused edition carousel, the vendored studio omits it, and OwnDashboard's copy schema has no hook field. The 12 news hooks are edition-promo lines and would not survive porting; the craft and news honesty rules would, and they already describe a 'calm plus hook cover' register that keeps every truth rule, apart from the blanket question ban and the Humanizer's 'canned hooks' line. The generic marketing skills mostly conflict with DNESKAi's register (follow/comment CTAs, rhetorical questions, first-person emotion); three carousel structures transfer. Consolidation is a cheap verbatim copy with an UPSTREAM.md and a sha256 pin test of the kind OwnDashboard already uses for the Humanizer. The register change itself is the owner's decision.

facts.fact: Hook definition: one line that opens a specific information gap the next slide is guaranteed to close.
facts.evidence: quorum/docs/hooks/01-hook-psychology.md:3-4 `A hook is one line that opens a **specific information gap the next slide is guaranteed to close**.`

facts.fact: Mechanism catalog (14): 1 information-gap curiosity (Loewenstein 1994, the core engine); 2 the clickbait tax, concrete beats vague (8,977-experiment meta-analysis, a constraint not a lever); 3 half-knowledge peak; 4 pretesting/productive failure; 5 illusion of explanatory depth (the one legitimate closed question); 6 loss aversion; 7 endowed progress and streaks; 8 precision effect (only with real data); 9 social norms and proof; 10 self-reference; 11 Zeigarnik (one ironic open loop at most); 12 von Restorff (vary archetypes, 20 % cap); 13 wear-out (cooldowns scale with intensity); 14 processing fluency (keep lines short).
facts.evidence: quorum/docs/hooks/01-hook-psychology.md:11,21,33,43,53,63,72,82,92,102,110,119,125,131 (section headings `## 1. Information-gap curiosity — the core engine` ... `## 14. Processing fluency (mostly a caution)`)

facts.fact: Lean-on order for the product: concrete gaps, IoED explain-challenges, half-knowledge, payoff-promise, precision stats once data exists, loss/streak carefully, one ironic open loop.
facts.evidence: quorum/docs/hooks/01-hook-psychology.md:141-151 `## What to lean on, in order (for this product)`

facts.fact: Craft voice: clipped, dry, confident; Czech tykani, native-first; no emoji, no exclamation marks, no hype adjectives; never beg for engagement.
facts.evidence: quorum/docs/hooks/02-hook-craft-rules.md:9-12 `No emoji. No exclamation marks. No hype adjectives` / `Never beg for engagement ("comment below", "don't skip").`

facts.fact: Hard limits: EN <= 58 chars, CS <= 66 chars, aim < 45, one line; CS <= 1.25x EN; no archetype above 20 % of a library. The lint enforces the same numbers.

Structural patterns: two-beat setup + turn ("X. Y."), concrete noun anchor, open a gap the next slide closes, promise the payoff not the content, questions only when unanswerable from the hook or IoED-backed.

Honesty rules: every claim licensed by a gate, tracked state or arithmetic; banned: fake timers, invented statistics, manufactured urgency or scarcity, unverifiable reader claims. Anti-pattern ban list of 7 (closed yes/no questions except IoED, bare difficulty labels, prohibition-only constraints, fake urgency, superlatives and engagement begging, calqued Czech, vague forward reference).

Carousel deltas: stats must be real; the reveal is the payoff and slides 2-4 must cash it; concreteness wins in-feed even more; hashtags never in the hook; the final CTA slide gets no hook mechanics, a quiet one.
facts.evidence: quorum/docs/hooks/02-hook-craft-rules.md:92-106 `The final CTA slide gets no hook mechanics. It's an ad; let it be a quiet one.`

facts.fact: Extra news honesty rules: never tease what the item does not deliver; no false novelty ("first", "breaking", age claims forbidden); attribute uncertainty and gate on sourceCount.
DNESKAi/Caught Up predicate vocabulary: always, sourceCount:N, primarySources:N, signalStrengthAtLeast:N, topicIn:X, hasNumber, all read from Quorum article frontmatter.

Assignment: eligible set by truthRequires (conjunction), channel cooldown max(2 x cooldownDays, 14), no same archetype on consecutive posts, seeded deterministic pick, agent override only within the set, `no-hook` fallback renders the template headline and never relaxes a gate.

Metrics and kill rules: no directional read before about 2,000 impressions per hook per slice; kill on completion -2pp or next-day return -1pp; about 5-8k impressions per arm to detect a 2pp lift. The results log is empty.
The news library is wired only into Quorum's edition carousel (`caught-up-carousel` channel), built from article frontmatter; hasNumber is a digit in the title or what_changed.

GoVIRAL hook families (5): curiosity (an open loop), story (a specific moment), value (the thing itself in the first line), contrarian (a held belief named and disagreed with), social proof (what happened, with the number). Write the hook, do not describe it.

GoVIRAL ranking: rate a play by what it is built to earn: sends, then time spent, then saves, then replies, then likes. Encoded weights: send 0.30, watch-time 0.20, save 0.18, reply 0.15, like 0.10, comment 0.07; a signal a platform does not document counts at undocumentedSignalFactor 0.5.

GoVIRAL trend score: three components (relative growth 0.45, absolute volume 0.25, source breadth 0.30) renormalised to 0-100, status words exploding (>= 70), regular, peaked (growth <= -0.3); a missing component is absent, not zero.

Carousel frameworks (5): A Value-Stack 4-14 slides (exact count cover), B Problem-Proof 6-10 (result as fact, receipt last), C Hack List 6-10 (contrarian stat cover, numbered hacks), D Rant Callout 4-8 (provocative claim, fairness pivot), E Demo Walkthrough 5-11 (outcome first, overview before detail). Cross rules: slide 1 is the thumbnail; one visual template per carousel.

Reverse-engineering method: 6 steps (niche ID of 10-20 creators, scrape 500-1000+ posts, analyze top 10 %, codify a playbook, layer voice, convert); step 2 names Apify and PhantomBuster. Quorum records this as a divergence: its quota-guarded Apify pipeline supersedes the step and no second account may be opened.

findings.title: GoVIRAL's signal fit ranks a like above a save on Instagram, contradicting its own sends-then-saves rule and the carousel guidance
findings.claim: The prompt and priors rank sends > time spent > saves > replies > likes (save weight 0.18 > like 0.10), but Instagram's documentedSignals list omits save, and signalFit multiplies an undocumented signal by 0.5 and normalises by the declared weights. A save-only play therefore scores 0.5 signal fit and a like-only play 1.0. The carousel framework says judge carousels on saves and completion.

truth.evidence: Arithmetic confirmed: signalFit (distribution-priors.ts:206-216) gives a save-only Instagram play 0.18*0.5/0.18 = 0.5 and a like-only play 1.0, because priors:157 omits save. But the omission is deliberate: priors:80-85 labels save an industry estimate that Meta's Feed page does not name. The contradiction is between the ordering weights and the fit formula, not an oversight; it affects GoVIRAL plays in Quorum, not OwnDashboard today.
